subject.name: Saint Wenceslaus, Martyr
subject.subtitle: c. 907–935
subject.blurb: A tenth-century duke of Bohemia who promoted Christianity, supported priests, and built churches while ruling his young state. He was killed at Stará Boleslav in a struggle with his brother Boleslav and was soon venerated as a martyr and patron of the Czech lands.
